source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 exam booklet screenshot, limits section only (also present in khexam_math_2022_2023.json, extracted from the source PDF)

exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា

questions.label: a
questions.technique: ∞·0 at infinity, reduced directly with the given standard log limit by substituting X=1/x → 0, turning x·ln(1+1/x) into ln(1+X)/X.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=-pi/2. Factor numerator via Pythagorean identity: 1-sin^2x=(1-sin x)(1+sin x); factor 2 from denominator: 2(1+sin x). Cancel (1+sin x), leaving (1-sin x)/2; substitute sin(-pi/2)=-1.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=3. Factor numerator x^3-27=(x-3)(x^2+3x+9); rationalize denominator sqrt(x+6)-3=(x-3)/(sqrt(x+6)+3). The (x-3) factors cancel, leaving (x^2+3x+9)(sqrt(x+6)+3)/27.
